review_type: Independent read-only editorial and semantic cross-review; root applied requested changes.

checks.assessment: Author line, PDF metadata and contribution paragraph use GPT-6 Astra (OpenAI), with no model-identity discussion. User supplied the version and author label.

Abstract and introduction retain original-row access. The underlying theorem charges 2 times input deficit plus 2 times helper entropy; the separate sharpness endpoints support the summary without claiming a native lower bound.

Fixed-degree bound is P-6 log(max(2,Delta))P/log d at d>=2 with all-input Correct and LocalTo. Abstract and introduction now explicitly require bijective recoding and all-input correctness; related work states the packet restrictions.

Exact abstract b floor(d^2/4) threshold equals the Lean natural-number expression b*(d*d/4). Helper is attainedHelper and entropy deficit uses the actual probability law. The summary limits its claim to the specified two-stage architecture.
Summaries concern omitted time in limiting physical head paths, specified scan palettes and regular recursion. They do not claim all non-affine motion fails or all recursion fails.

Read outer exists A,H,K0,E then forall M exists same M prime, all canonical dimensions/input/output/time bounds; complete-run zero-slack cut follows for arbitrary halting payload. Full M* is under linear payload time and diverging dimensions. Abstract, introduction and roadmap now preserve this distinction.

Padding is described as supplying the geometric conditions independently of the transpose computation, not as a transposer, a Tape Coding Conjecture refutation, or an unrestricted time lower bound. Introduction explains the additional demand/causal-code obligations.

Directly read endpoint and definition: forall C,k,G,c (G>=1), every threshold admits one dimension where all valid cP diagrams with final-P-step output and all sets of cardinality deficit <=Cd lack codes. Roadmap now explicitly states no such diagram and code at those sizes. T yields codes at every sufficiently large size. This is weaker than full robust eventual no-code with O(db) deficit.

The endpoint compares total capacities and demand-weighted row distances with factor entryBits(d), under fixed constants, validity/profile, O(P) horizon and O(db) coentropy. The roadmap restricts its Omega(log d) coding-versus-routing requirement to the relevant tape networks and retains the separate uniform finite-state realization obligation.
Causal-output invariant is explicitly proposed, not proved. Escaping a restricted class is explicitly not feasibility. Candidate rejection is by quantitative contradiction, not mere model membership.

First paper credited to Hans Brende and Claude Opus 5.5; its native/cut/limit/coding machinery is imported. Local coding is not portrayed as strengthening a prior separator/two-stage theorem. Four unformalized background propositions confirmed in the first paper introduction and retained as background.

Compared all 25 bibliography keys with the source ledger and read all scope limits. BY expander mathematics and pinned OpenAI scalar-projection proof are separately credited. No exhaustive novelty claim; one-tape and binary-width scope differences retained. No new web search in this editorial pass.

Read prior-art conversion note and independently checked user-supplied Mittal thesis PDF pages169 and197 with pypdf. Thesis attributes proof to Mark Braverman and Katherine Forbes; manuscript correctly cites accessible thesis and distinguishes earlier implied caching counterexamples from explicit refutations. They are not claimed as new Lean results.

Lean toolchain and inherited Mathlib manifest pin are v4.34.1; adapter references sibling sources directly. Read verify.py: source hashes, all annotation modules, exact axiom report coverage and whitelist checks. Manuscript accurately distinguishes ordinary build/transitive audit from fresh proof replay and AI review from external human peer review. Support receipt records6313 prior declarations.

Abstract, introduction, roadmap and related work consistently leave unrestricted linear-time transposition/multiplication undecided. No restricted model is silently generalized to arbitrary tape computations.
